notes: 1 not-started task(s) that MS Project would schedule before the data date are given Start No Earlier Than the data date, as MS Project's Update Project does (A1390).
Resource assignments on 1 milestone(s) are left out: MS Project can't schedule work on a zero-length milestone (A1000).
Baselines, notes, steps, expenses and activity fields (UDFs) are not carried. MS Project reschedules on opening with its own rules, so check the finish date.
